python -c "
import toolz
from collections import OrderedDict, defaultdict

# R1: compose_left
print('R1: compose_left')
inc = lambda i: i + 1
double = lambda i: i * 2
result = toolz.compose_left(inc, double)(3)
print(f'compose_left(inc, double)(3) = {result}')
assert result == 8

# R2: peekn
print('R2: peekn')
peekn_result = list(toolz.peekn(3, range(10)))
print(f'peekn(3, range(10)) = {peekn_result}')
assert peekn_result == [0, 1, 2]

# R3: dissoc optimized
print('R3: dissoc')
dissoc_result = toolz.dissoc({'x': 1, 'y': 2}, 'y')
print(f'dissoc({{\"x\": 1, \"y\": 2}}, \"y\") = {dissoc_result}')
assert dissoc_result == {'x': 1}

# R4: Compose class
print('R4: Compose class')
c = toolz.Compose([lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x * 2])
compose_result = c(3)
print(f'Compose([inc, double])(3) = {compose_result}')
assert compose_result == 8

# R5: fold (already exists)
print('R5: fold')
fold_result = toolz.fold(lambda x, y: x + y, [], 0)
print(f'fold(add, [], 0) = {fold_result}')
assert fold_result == 0

# R6: merge with Mapping types
print('R6: merge with Mapping types')
od = OrderedDict([('a', 1), ('b', 2)])
merge_od = toolz.merge(od, {'c': 3})
print(f'merge(OrderedDict, dict) returns: {type(merge_od)}')
assert isinstance(merge_od, OrderedDict), f'Expected OrderedDict, got {type(merge_od)}'

dd = defaultdict(int, {'a': 1, 'b': 2})
merge_dd = toolz.merge(dd, {'c': 3})
print(f'merge(defaultdict, dict) returns: {type(merge_dd)}')
assert isinstance(merge_dd, defaultdict), f'Expected defaultdict, got {type(merge_dd)}'

# R7: Python 3 only (verified earlier)
print('R7: Python 3 only - verified')

# R8: anext support (in test file)
print('R8: anext in blacklist - verified')

# apply
print('apply')
apply_result = toolz.apply(lambda x: x + 1, (1,))
print(f'apply(lambda x: x + 1, (1,)) = {apply_result}')
assert apply_result == 2

print('All requirements verified!')
"
